description: This is a PHP source file defining a controller class WelcomeController within the OrangeHRM installer module. It handles pre-render setup for the welcome screen of the installer application, configuring a Vue.js component with version info.

classes.name: WelcomeController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for preparing the welcome screen of the installer, extending AbstractInstallerVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component for the welcome screen with version info and updates the current screen state.
